entries.title: ANTI-PATTERN: 10-Core SetBlockDim(10) Cold DVFS Bimodal Latency Spike
entries.summary: Avoid SetBlockDim(10) on soc-a: warmed local medians mask a ~9us bimodal DVFS down-clocking spike on the first 1-2 runs that hits online 3-run scoring. Always stick to {1, 4, 8, 20, 40}.

evidence.note: online & cold3 revealed 9us first-2-run DVFS spike in 10-core mode; fixed in 9c943d3 (5.26->3.96us)
profiler cold3 verification confirmed 10-core mode degraded latency by +1.30us (5.26 vs 3.96us) compared to controlled core ladder
profiler showed non-20/40 partial block counts triggered unstable cold run1 spikes

entries.title: ANTI-PATTERN: Dummy SetBlockDim(halfCores)/20 + Early Return on Small Shapes
entries.summary: Never launch 1-core small shapes with dummy SetBlockDim(halfCores)/SetBlockDim(20) + early return (`if (GetBlockIdx() != 0) return;`): hides local idle-die 1c DVFS spikes while adding online dispatch overhead (`-11.83 pts` on StridedSliceGrad 734e097), and `(maxCores+1)/2` hits the 10-core DVFS trap on 20c soc-b.

evidence.note: Online scored 59.74 vs 71.57 (Public #3 3.95->4.56us); `(maxCores+1)/2` also hits 10-core trap on 20c soc-b.

entries.title: Accel soc-a 16 KB AIV L1I Iron Law & Multi-TU Hybrid COMDAT/Static Linker Layout
entries.summary: Pack hot kernel entries (_0.._2 / _0.._3) contiguously inside 0x0000..0x4000 (<= 16 KB AIV L1 I-Cache) and slim .text/.o_max. Across multiple TUs, mark shared cross-schMode helpers `inline __attribute__((noinline))` (WEAK COMDAT saves 5-10 KB) while keeping single-schMode hot helpers `static __attribute__((noinline))` adjacent to callers with zero cross-section jump.

evidence.note: online verified packing _0+_1 <= 15 KB inside 16 KB AIV L1I with COMDAT dedup
online verified <13.9 KB L1I hot-1c ordering on PadV3Grad / CTCLossV2 / ConfusionTransposeD / StridedSliceGrad

entries.title: ANTI-PATTERN: Compiler/arch-v1 Inner-Loop noinline, rank<=8 unroll(disable), & >7-8 Scalar Args HBM Stack Spill
entries.summary: Online-verified Compiler compiler & ABI redlines on Accel soc-a: (1) NEVER call `noinline` inside hot loops or put `#pragma clang loop unroll(disable)` on `rank<=8` short loops (StridedSliceGrad a690e69 dropped -7.24 pts online); (2) NEVER pass >7-8 scalar arguments (or const-struct/LocalTensor refs) to `noinline` callees — excess args inevitably spill to HBM stack (verified on CTCLossV2/ConcatD/PadV3Grad/StridedSliceGrad).

evidence.note: online dropped -7.24 pts from inner-loop noinline ExpandStep2Cold + unroll(disable) on short rank/odo loops
profiler confirmed >7-8 scalar args to noinline callees spill to HBM stack across CTC/ConcatD/PadV3Grad/SSG

entries.title: Accel soc-a Multi-Core Iron Laws: No PreLoad(N), 32B/64B Slot Alignment (>16c), & Safe Capability Bailout
entries.summary: Online-verified multi-core silicon laws on Accel soc-a: (1) NEVER use `KernelC::PreLoad(N)`, dummy `SetBlockDim(4/halfCores)`, or `10c` (fix core ladder to {1,4,8,20,40}); (2) for `cores > 16`, keep per-core workspace slots 32B/64B aligned (`slotStride=1` caused L2 false sharing losing -3..-4 pts on MML); (3) in multi-core fast-path kernels, NEVER write `if (b0 >= B) return true;` before capability fallback checks (idle cores return early while active cores fall through -> silent WA).

evidence.note: online verified 32B/64B per-core slot stride eliminated -3..-4 pt L2 false sharing on 20-40 cores
online verified capability bailout must precede `if (b0 >= B) return true;` and PreLoad(N) must be banned
